# BOM · Structure, Glazing & Storage

*The building itself — frame, envelope, glazing, vents, doors, beds/benches — plus the **storage systems** that make a class of 25 actually workable. Implements [REQ-STR-*](../../design/10-requirements.md#a-structure--envelope), the passive features ([REQ-PASV](../../design/10-requirements.md#m-passive-architecture)), and the zone layout ([80](../../design/80-zone-layout.md)). Foundation/slab itself is in the [slab pre-pour checklist](../00-slab-prepour-checklist.md).*

> **Status:** 🟡 Scaffolding. It's a **custom, sealed-design** structure — the 🔴 Red architect/engineer specifies frame material, wind/hail rating, and connections. Examples are "or equal."

## F. Tool & implement storage — *the class-scale system*

> A trowel is small; **30 trowels need an organizational system.** Storage here is designed for a class of 25 to grab-and-return fast, for "what's missing" to be obvious at a glance, and for sharp tools to lock up.

| Item | Spec / Model (or "or equal") | Qty | REQ trace | Source | Unit $ | Ext $ | Lead | Status | Notes |
|------|------------------------------|-----|-----------|--------|--------|-------|------|--------|-------|
| **Shadow boards / French-cleat tool wall** | Outlined home for every tool | TBD | REQ-STR-7 | TBD | TBD | TBD | TBD | proposed | Missing tool obvious at a glance; foolproof return |
| **Numbered class-set caddies** | Per table-group totes (trowels, forks, gloves) | TBD | REQ-STR-7 | TBD | TBD | TBD | TBD | proposed | 30-second hand-out/collect; count-checkable |
| Lockable tool/amendment cabinet | Sharp/edged tools + amendments locked when unsupervised | 1 | REQ-SAFE-4 | TBD | TBD | TBD | TBD | proposed | Ties to operating safety |
| Kid-height + ADA storage station | Reachable by K–5 + wheelchair | 1 | REQ-EDU-2, REQ-ACC-1 | TBD | TBD | TBD | TBD | proposed | |
| Tool-care station | Sand + oil bucket; rags | 1 | REQ-STR-7 | TBD | TBD | TBD | TBD | proposed | Rust control (humid house) + a care *lesson* |
| Hand tools | **Stainless/coated** (rust-resistant) trowels, forks, cultivators, pruners | ~30+ | REQ-STR-7 | TBD | TBD | TBD | TBD | proposed | Class-set quantities |
| Gloves / PPE | Kid + adult sizes | TBD | REQ-SAFE-4 | TBD | TBD | TBD | TBD | proposed | |
| Watering cans / trugs / buckets | Nesting | TBD | REQ-EDU-2 | TBD | TBD | TBD | TBD | proposed | |

## Notes
- **Custom + sealed design:** frame, wind/hail rating, and connections are the 🔴 Red engineer's call — this BOM lists *what*, not the stamped *how*.
- **Storage is a layout item too** — the tool wall + station want a home in the [zone layout](../../design/80-zone-layout.md) (near the work/repotting zone + entry).
- **Rust is the enemy** in a humid greenhouse — stainless/coated tools + dry storage + the care station.
